Sed intuere calumniandi impudentiam! Ea fpretâ ab illis, velut pararent, objiciebantur.

Omnem vero in amicitia fimulata nequitiam fupe-rat, quod de circumvento Titio Sabino adjicitur. Hunc Latiaris cum perfidiæ fociis aggreditur: cupidine con- fulatus, ad quem non nifi per Sejanum aditus. neque Sejani voluntas, nifi fcelere, quarebatur. O maculatum honorum fplendorem, qui turpitudine emitur! Latia-ris jacere fortuitos primum fermones, mox laudare con-ftantiam, quod non, ut cateri, florentis domus amicus, adfliftam deferuiffet. O cacodæmonis humana fpe-cie verfutiam! nos abinfidiatoribus ejufmodi & fer-monum fatoribus, compreffaintra fauces voce, ca-veamus. The left-margin notes "Calumnia", "audacia", "Titii Sabini" and "vafus" are transcribed as printed but their exact placement and wording is uncertain. Running head reading is approximate. The final line "nega-" is a hyphenated break carried onto the next page. Some words in the central text, notably "Latiaris" and "ventitare", and the Latin phrases in the lower half, are uncertain and should be checked against the scan.
